liblevenshtein.summary: Fast spelling correction and fuzzy search with Levenshtein automata
liblevenshtein.description: A high-performance library for spelling correction, fuzzy dictionary search, and phonetic matching using Levenshtein and related finite-state automata.

liblevenshtein-macros.summary: Compile regular expressions into liblevenshtein automata at build time
liblevenshtein-macros.description: Compile regular expressions into liblevenshtein NFAs at build time, with generated transitions and diagnostics checked before runtime.

libdictenstein.summary: High-performance dictionaries and trie-maps for approximate string matching
libdictenstein.description: High-performance dictionaries and trie-maps for approximate string matching.

lling-llang.summary: Build and compose weighted automata for speech, text, and language processing
lling-llang.description: Build, compose, optimize, and run semiring-generic weighted automata for speech recognition, text processing, and constrained generation.

duallity.summary: Compose fuzzy dictionary search with phonetics, grammars, and language models
duallity.description: Turn fuzzy dictionary queries into lazy weighted transducers that compose with phonetic rewrites, grammars, language models, and custom lling-llang pipelines.

vinary-tree-interop.summary: Share live dictionaries and weighted automata safely across languages
vinary-tree-interop.description: A stable, dependency-free resource ABI for sharing live dictionaries, weighted automata, and host-defined algebra safely across Vinary Tree libraries and languages.

llattice.summary: Lawful lattice algebra for composable native and host-language systems
llattice.description: A dependency-free Rust lattice trait with lawful built-ins and host-language provider adapters for shared join and meet semantics.

javascript-runtime.summary: One runtime for Vinary Tree dictionaries and automata on Node, WASM, and WASI
javascript-runtime.description: A single-instance native, WebAssembly, and WASI runtime that lets Vinary Tree JavaScript packages safely share live dictionaries and weighted automata.

liblevenshtein-npm-compatibility.summary: Fast Rust-powered spelling correction and fuzzy search for JavaScript
liblevenshtein-npm-compatibility.description: The Rust-powered liblevenshtein JavaScript facade for fast spelling correction and fuzzy search across Node, WebAssembly, and WASI.
